sources.citation: Capell, Arthur (1942). Languages of Arnhem Land, North Australia [Part I]. Oceania 12(4): 364-392; Mangeri (4) and Uningangk (5) section pp. 372-374.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on Uningangk stress. The general 'A. Phonetics' section (pp. 364-367) covers plosives, velar fricative, trilled r, glottal stop, vowels, g/w interchange only; the Mangeri/Uningangk pages give pronoun paradigms, adjective class forms, a tense sketch and a comparative vocabulary (pp. 372-374). The only accent remark in Part I is about Burera ('accenting the first syllable in all cases', p. 375).

sources.note: Both cite Campbell 2006 as sole source; 23 segments in PHOIBLE, no suprasegmental or stress data.
